title: Toggle an item done with one request
goal: A checkbox in a client can flip an item without reading it first.

acceptance_criteria.text: POST /todos/:id/toggle flips done and answers 200 with the updated item.
An unknown id answers 404; any other method on that path answers 405. Other routes behave as before.

context.notes: Keep node:http only; no dependencies. Add tests for every acceptance criterion.
